m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: Hmmm.
No, I hit the button. I am just thinking about where we should go next. The Hierophant spell has shape, but needs meaning.
Both positive and negative meaning. The spell must embody the true signification of the Hierophant: that of tradition, conformity and adherence.
It must likewise encompass the reversed meaning: rebellion, individuality and LEMURIA! That is where you must go.
Find the Hierarchs that so clung to the edicts of the Old One, and the Lemurs that rejected him: The Koola Kollada or whatever they're called.
Put them in a room together and let the enchantment I cast upon you record the event.
DOOM! Get your doom here, prophecies of certain doom! Also destruction. We even have promises of plagues - boils, locusts, frogs, they're going fast!
YOU! You propelled us into the sky! You brought mana and life and hope to our world. You really dried up the doom market.
Life was so much easier when we were abandoned by our creator. His rules bound us in a shared fate, but now, NOW, everyone seeks their own destiny.
Yes, like the Koolakamba, wretched hooligans. Why would I ever treat with them? Hmm, I suppose it could reunite our fractured society.
Lots of new stress, lots more interest in omens of sheer doom. Okay, I'm in.
Find a Koolakamba representative in the Wildlands and meet me in the Temple of Unity.
Actually it was the Temple of Tattered Robes. Laundry room, basically. But it can be both. So bring a Koolakamba to the Temple of Tattered Unity!
You want us to meet and reconcile with the Hierarchs? NO! I could never do that! What? No, not because of intractable philosophical differences.
I'm just busy. I'm supposed to hunt The Great Game as part of a ritual or contest, possibly a prank, I wasn't paying attention.
I tracked the thing to a cave, but it's cold and I don't want to deal with it. But if the Great Game was defeated, I'd have free time.
Hint, hint.
You smell great gamey.
Also like victory!
I can smell victory, you know, also failure, and shame.
So I guess I'm free. What do you want to do? Treat with the Hierarchs in Telos, huh? Sure. I can do that. Where do I go?
Temple of Tattered Unity? That probably smells like shame, I can find my way.
That was a very scary lady. Does she bring doom upon us all? Should we worship her?
What is a Hieropants? That's not a real word.
Ehhh, just take your scary spell witch and go before you cause a...
...PANIC!
MMMMMMmmmhhhmmm
Apologies. I sometimes forget the talk button. Now, Wizard, you must submit...
...To disciplinary action. You left the Arcanum for unsanctioned REVENGE and now must return and report to the Scholar of Applied Magicks!
Since when was that you? What do you mean there was a ceremony? Why was I not invited? Perhaps I should get some unsanctioned REVENGE of my own!
Meh, why bother? At least I finally get to see Darkmoor; I tried to transfer here many times in the Cabal. For the challenge, you see, and the Scholomance.
Yes, I know the Scholomance can corrupt, but I wear a mask, so I should be fine. Perhaps we can even try to make a new spell with its teachings.
Have you seen the cards that can tell the future? They are Scholomantic, but the Cabal found a way to safely sync them with normal magical Schools.
We just need to use an incantation to harness your experience and fuse it into a form, meaning and School we choose. Now what was that phrase?
Mmmmmhmhmmmhmhmhmmmhmhmhmmmh.
There. That should do it, for a while. Now which card should we turn into your new spell? And what form should it take? Ah, the Hierophant, good choice.
A card of rigid tradition and the safety of familiar ritual. Sounds like Ice to me. Now... these Sisters have a Hierophant of their-
Defeated, eh? If only there was some way to recapture past moments of where she has been. Ah, Shadow Photomancy! Of course! I have no idea what that is.
But use it to photomance past appearances by the Scholomari Hierophant to give our spell its form.
